# F3: Fit and finish, wizard

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/3-wizard.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

fit and finish, wizard (per-area reports, 4 Nov). New goal (GoalWizard), Edit goal (GoalEdit) and the plan table. Numbers in brackets are the report's findings.
